tutorial.title: Intro to APIs
tutorial.descriptionContent: Transfer API request skills to less guided Python tasks.
tutorial.shortDescriptionContent: Python learners who want additional API practice

lessons.title: Plan a Forecast Request
lessons.interactiveContent:
A dashboard only needs the current forecast from /forecasts/vienna. Which request plan matches the task?

Send a GET request to the endpoint without a request bodySend a POST request with a new forecastSend a PATCH request with one changed fieldSend a DELETE request to the endpoint

Send a GET request to the endpoint without a request body.

lessons.interactiveContent:

executableContent.instructions: Complete `load_character()` so it sends a `GET` request to the supplied URL, raises an HTTP error for an unsuccessful response, and returns the character name from the parsed JSON.

files.name: script.py
files.content:
import requests

def load_character():
  url = "https://api.example.com/characters/7"
  data = response.json()
  return data["name"]
files.solvedContent:
import requests

def load_character():
  url = "https://api.example.com/characters/7"
  response = requests.get(url)
  response.raise_for_status()
  data = response.json()
  return data["name"]

executableContent.instructions: Complete `update_profile()` so it sends the supplied username as a JSON update to the profile URL, raises an HTTP error for an unsuccessful response, and returns the username (key `"username"`) from the parsed JSON.

files.name: script.py
files.content:
import requests

def update_profile():
  url = "https://api.example.com/profiles/12"
  data = {"username": "nova_coder"}
  response = requests.patch(url, json=data)
  response.raise_for_status()
  return ""
files.solvedContent:
import requests

def update_profile():
  url = "https://api.example.com/profiles/12"
  data = {"username": "nova_coder"}
  response = requests.patch(url, json=data)
  response.raise_for_status()
  result = response.json()
  return result["username"]
